acceptance_criteria.description: Existing historical import v1 records validate and project identically.
Task-level rows bind source run, unit/case/question, attempt, metric, denominator, outcome, and provenance.
Failure, timeout, invalid, no-output, and missing outcomes remain explicit and non-success.
Aggregate and task rows have explicit relationships and deterministic identities.
Focused tests and repository validation pass with exact results reported.

objective: Extend the non-claim historical import contract so ledger and paper-table rows retain source run, unit, attempt, outcome, denominator, and aggregate relationship without changing BMP execution semantics.
title: Preserve task-level identities and outcomes in historical imports
